description: load_tls_server_config and load_tls_server_config_with_key_bytes use ServerConfig::builder_with_protocol_versions(&[&rustls::version::TLS13, &rustls::version::TLS12]). This is correct, but the function comment says 'requires TLS 1.2 or higher' while the actual enforcement is in the protocol_versions slice passed to rustls. If a future refactor changes this slice (e.g. to add a TLS10 compatibility shim), there is no guard preventing it. Consider asserting at test time that the returned ServerConfig's advertised protocol versions do not include TLS 1.0 or 1.1. There are currently no tests that inspect the ServerConfig's protocol version list.
title: tls: load_tls_server_config has no min TLS version guard; caller must use TLS13+TLS12 slice
